purpose: DRAFT ONLY. No run has been launched. This file records the design for a matched-recipe replication of the Stage 0 recurrent-vs-feedforward comparison at 112 px. Decision thresholds are deliberately not set here.
question: Does the recurrent flagship beat feedforward at 112 px under a matched recipe, after accounting for the two confounds found after the Stage 0 verdict (batch 48 vs 64; contaminated flagship seed 17)?

confounds_addressed.description: Stage 0 trained ff_112 at loader batch 48 (2,639 steps/epoch, 39,585 steps over 15 epochs) and recurrence_112 at loader batch 64 (1,979 steps/epoch, 29,685 steps). The replication trains every arm at batch 64.

The Stage 0 recurrence_112 seed 17 final checkpoint has an AdamW step counter of 21,762, consistent with a fresh optimizer from epoch 5 (11 x 1,979 = 21,769), not 15 continuous epochs. The local epoch-4 rolling checkpoint has five parameter groups and zero optimizer state entries. The replication reruns seed 17 under the empty-state guard.

R1.description: Clean recurrence_112 seed-17 rerun at matched batch 64 on the pinned new tip.

R2.description: Feedforward 112 baselines retrained at matched batch 64 for all three Stage 0 seeds.

existing_flagship_seed42.description: Stage 0 recurrence_112 seed 42 was trained at batch 64, has a continuous optimizer history (29,668 steps vs 15 x 1,979 = 29,685), and had no observed reset. Current design intent is to reuse it rather than retrain it.

pinned_commit_status: OPEN - fill with the full 40-character SHA of the clean tip at launch. The tip must contain B1-B5 and the empty-state guard.

infra.required_gates: B1-B5 passed on the pinned clean tree
infra.empty_optimizer_state_guard: active; a checkpoint with optimizer.state entries == 0 at saved epoch >= 1 must abort unless allow_fresh_optimizer is explicitly passed
infra.resume_equivalence: scripts/test_resume_equivalence.py must pass with exact weight/RNG equality on the pinned tip
infra.strict_abort_tests: tests/test_resume_strict_abort.py must pass on the pinned tip

data.augmentation: RandomResizedCrop(112, scale 0.35-1.0), horizontal flip, ImageNet normalization

optimization.scheduler: 3-epoch linear warmup then cosine decay, stepped once per epoch

adversarial.curriculum: constant across epochs; epsilon and TRADES weights do not change with epoch

recipe.checkpoint_policy: final epoch only; no selection on validation or evaluation images

evaluation.battery: Stage 0 canonical harness: clean + PGD-50 + APGD-CE + APGD-DLR at eps = 5.417/255
evaluation.slice: full 5,000-image ImageNet-100 validation split; the 1k canonical slice is not used for the decision
evaluation.worst_case: bitwise AND of PGD-50, APGD-CE, APGD-DLR correctness arrays
evaluation.per_sample_artifacts: one .npz per arm with per-sample correctness arrays

analysis.primary: Compare recurrent and feedforward worst-case robust accuracy on the full 5k surface at matched batch 64.
analysis.per_seed: Report clean, PGD-50, APGD-CE, APGD-DLR, and worst-case for every seed.
analysis.pooling: Pooled McNemar exact two-sided test on discordant pairs, subject to the OPEN threshold decision.
analysis.selection: No checkpoint selection; evaluate the epoch-15 final checkpoint only.
analysis.thresholds: OPEN - no thresholds are chosen in this draft.
